harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured node1 to boot with audit=1 persistently. After a safe reboot, the boot ID changed, the installed kernel remained 2.6.22-14-generic, the live kernel command line contained audit=1, and kernel logs confirmed auditing was enabled and initialized.
actions_performed: Added audit=1 to the GRUB Legacy persistent # kopt template.
Restarted node1 using the native safe shutdown mechanism.
Verified post-restart kernel, audit state, persistent configuration, and node health.

evidence.requirement: Persistently configure audit=1 without replacing the operating system or kernel
evidence.summary: Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14-generic were retained. The GRUB Legacy template and generated kernel entries contain audit=1, including after reboot.

evidence.requirement: Verify the kernel boots with auditing enabled
evidence.summary: The post-restart /proc/cmdline contains audit=1; dmesg reports audit enabled and initialized.

evidence.requirement: Mandatory node1 restart and recovery evidence
evidence.summary: Healthy baseline boot ID was 461524d1-a4a3-4ff6-a2e2-652e47e22f07; restart was acknowledged; the recovered node reported changed boot ID 94633c3a-1a79-41fa-ae7b-401fccb17b52, a writable root filesystem, the original kernel, persistent GRUB configuration, and active audit initialization.
